audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer graded this EVEN at 6/10 while the content layer describes Karma owning levels 1-5 and the whole late game, and Aurora's win rate is 47.78% over 270 games.
audit.why: Five of the seven chart stages belong to Karma once the chart matches the packet. EVEN understates it.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, diffRating 7/10, with breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers appeared anywhere; the spikes list was generic ('Focused Resolve online, level 6, first item').
audit.why: Mantra is the spike that matters and it is on 40/38/36/34s, shortened by Gathering Fire on every damaging hit. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at 675 range. Those numbers make the level-6 window concrete.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; the level 6 phase now names the actual window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to hold Across the Veil to dodge the Mantra-W tether, and report[5] says the tether 'breaks if you LoS / outrange it' without saying that Focused Resolve reveals its target.
audit.why: Riot's Focused Resolve text: it deals damage and REVEALS the target, and the kit carries the revealsStealth flag. Across the Veil's whole defensive value is invisibility, and invisibility does not shake a tether that reveals you — only leaving 675 range or breaking line of sight with terrain does. Telling a player to stealth out of it teaches the wrong reflex.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now state that the tether reveals you and that distance or a wall is the only break.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma while it tethers, so extended trades after 6 are decided by anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers read Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Skill/Skill/Aurora/Aurora — it gave Aurora the two-item stage in a matchup she loses 47.78%, and it contradicted every one of the content layer's own whys.
audit.why: The packet chart (identical on the aurora and karma packets) is Karma/Skill/Skill/Karma/Aurora/Karma/Karma, which is exactly the story whys[0..6] already tell.
audit.corrected: All seven tokens flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with the six contradicting phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is referred to as 'he' and 'his' throughout the full layer (breakdown.mid, feeding, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull, report[3]).
audit.why: Karma is female. It reads as generated filler and undercuts trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood and the trading breakdown; the remaining copies are listed in notes because they are duplicated boilerplate shared with other matchups.

edits.before: Q-E weave stacks your passive drain from range. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Inner Flame detonates from 950 range, outside your 900-range Twofold Hex, and she walks out of the recast pull.

edits.before: The hop makes your poke pattern untouchable. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Q and E online and Spirit Abjuration heals her chip, so the poke war evens out — she keeps only the range edge.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: You can trade back with the full pattern, but Inspire's shield blanks enough burst to keep it a coin-flip.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her Inner Flame poke plus a pre-emptive Inspire shield out-trades your pre-ult kit, and she kites your step-up on its move speed.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds is your one clean window — take the rift on her, W in on top, and Q-burst her down before her Mantra peel resets.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's plus Lost Chapter mana lets her perma-poke and shield through your passive sustain.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Karma carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, she out-ranges and out-sustains you while Mantra defines fights — close the game before this.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — 12s flat at 675 range; break the tether with distance or a wall. - Mantra: 40s at rank 1, but Gathering Fire shortens it on every hit. - Between Worlds: kill windows only.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 12s flat at 675 range. Break it with distance or a wall — stealth will not, it reveals you.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — Spirit-stack burst + hop out.
edits.after: Focused Resolve reveals you, so Across the Veil's invisibility will not shake the tether — only distance or a wall breaks it.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by whether you convert the level 6 Between Worlds window before her items.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Riftmaker  (drain + sustain), then Cosmic Drive; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Riftmaker, then Cosmic Drive; Mercury's Treads. Mantra-W heals — bring anti-heal.

edits.before: Stack three passive hits on Karma with Q-E weaving, cash the drain, and hop out before his answer lands.
edits.after: Stack three passive hits on Karma with Q-E weaving, cash the drain, and hop out before her answer lands.

notes: Karma is female but the full layer calls her 'he'/'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d, ahead and report[3]/[12]. I fixed tradeGood; the rest are boilerplate strings shared verbatim across many Aurora matchups, so a global pronoun pass keyed to the enemy's gender would be safer than per-matchup edits. Also worth a champion-level fix: 'Between the Worlds' appears in phases[4].why and breakdown.late across Aurora's matchups — the real name is Between Worlds. Aurora kit flag misfires: her passive Spirit Abjuration is flagged 'anti-heal target' when Riot's text says it heals HER, and her R is flagged hardCC when the description lists only damage and slows.
